issue_context.title: Setting global sysdate_is_now won't work
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

```sql
mysql> show variables like 'sysdate_is_now';
+----------------+-------+
| Variable_name  | Value |
+----------------+-------+
| sysdate_is_now | OFF   |
+----------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> set global sysdate_is_now=true;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

create a new session 

mysql> explain select * from t where d > sysdate();
+-------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| id                      | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                  |
+-------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| TableReader_7           | 8000.00  | root      |               | data:Selection_6               |
| └─Selection_6           | 8000.00  | cop[tikv] |               | gt(test.t.d, sysdate())        |
|   └─TableFullScan_5     | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t       | keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
+-------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
3 rows in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> show variables like 'sysdate_is_now';
+----------------+-------+
| Variable_name  | Value |
+----------------+-------+
| sysdate_is_now | ON    |
+----------------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)


```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

sysdate() should be replaced as now()

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

sysdate instead of now()

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: Why remove this function since it could be set globally?
We don't need to inplement `SetGlobal` , `GetGlobal` here, the `setSysVariable` already handles it.
